question:
Which of the following options is the closest approximate value which will come in place of the question mark(?) in the following equation?

895.98 + 185.01 + 851.86 + 524.09 = ?
solution: Given: 895.98 +185.01 + 851.86 + 524.09 Concept used: Closest approximate value : If after decimal the digit > 5, then add 1 to the digits preceding the decimal
